title: Nimble German Swede Pancake
description: A fresh, fluffy pancake flavored with grated swede and a hint of ferment, perfect for kids and quick family breakfasts.
instructions: Preheat a small nonstick skillet over medium heat and lightly oil it.
In a large bowl, whisk together flour, baking powder, and salt until well mixed.
In another bowl, beat eggs, milk, melted butter, and vanilla until frothy.
Add the grated swede to the wet mixture and stir until evenly distributed.
Combine wet and dry ingredients, stirring just until a smooth batter forms; add the cider vinegar for a subtle tang.
Pour a 1/4 cup of batter onto the skillet, forming a round pancake; cook 2-3 minutes until bubbles appear on the surface.
Flip the pancake and cook another 1-2 minutes until golden brown; repeat with remaining batter.
Sprinkle chopped dill over the hot pancakes, serve warm, and enjoy.
